falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom featured a sustained breakdown with no immediate V-recovery above prior resistance; a clean breakout to new highs this quickly would prove this is not that pattern and the 'bottom' call was wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 39 suggests elevated fear/uncertainty that should persist in a true bottom formation; rapid VIX compression below 14 would indicate complacency returning, invalidating the bottom thesis and showing the signal was just noise

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while SPX simultaneously makes a new 20-day low
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with yields rising (growth scare); if yields collapse with stocks still breaking down, this indicates a recession panic rather than a growth-scare bottom, making the pattern match structurally invalid

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
